Class InvoiceCloneControllerTest

@IsTest()
private class InvoiceCloneControllerTest

Unit tests for InvoiceCloneController. Validates invoice cloning for both alphanumeric and numeric invoice number formats, line item cloning, and error handling when cloning fails.

Methods

@IsTest
private static void alphaNumericTest()

Tests cloning an invoice with an alphanumeric number format (e.g., INV-0037). Verifies the cloned invoice has an incremented number (INV-0038), today's date, and all line items are copied.

@IsTest
private static void exceptionTest()

Tests the error handling path when cloning fails. Uses an invoice number that causes an overflow on increment, verifying that an empty string is returned and an ErrorLog__c record is created.

@IsTest
private static void numericTest()

Tests cloning an invoice with a purely numeric number format (e.g., 00038). Verifies the cloned invoice has an incremented number (00039) with preserved zero-padding and no line items when the original has none.
